hook: Cold-temperature assembly makes carbon nanospheres with straight radial pores for sodium storage.

readout.label: Capacity retention after 1000 cycles at 2 A g-1

summary: Using sheet-like polymer micelles grown at 5 C instead of spherical ones, the team made wrinkled carbon nanospheres about 910 nm wide with 36 nm pores that connect 96% of the way through. As a sodium-ion anode they kept 90.5% capacity after 1000 cycles and beat commercial hard carbon. Tests were on small lab cells.
title: Low-Temperature-Mediated Lamellar–Micelle Assembly of Wrinkled Mesoporous Carbon Nanospheres with Aligned Pores and High Interconnectivity
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
